rows.setting_scope: Applies to UB-04 inpatient/outpatient facilities, bundling routine room, board, and integral services.

reimbursement_policies.evidence: This policy bundles routine room, board, nursing, supply, respiratory, tracheostomy, and ventilator/CPAP components into the facility charge; separate reimbursement is not allowed for routine or integral components.

utilization_limits: 1 unit/day for ventilator or CPAP management

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: Bundle inclusive hospital facility charges on UB-04 Medicaid claims by denying separate payment for revenue codes 250, 260-269, 270-279, 300-370, 391, 410, and 412, with priority review in OTHER and long-term care hospital settings where volume or paid per admission is rising. Peer: United Health bundles revenue codes 250, 260-269, 270-279, 300-370, 391, 410, and 412 as inclusive hospital facility charges on UB-04 Medicaid claims..

IA — Enforce a utilization limit of 1 unit/day for ventilator or CPAP management on UB-04 Medicaid facility claims, including non-acute settings showing spend migration. United Health limits ventilator or CPAP management to 1 unit/day on UB-04 Medicaid facility claims..
